name: GaugeRing
description: Radial gauge ring showing a single KPI as an animated SVG arc with counter tween, label, and optional comparison ring.

value.description: The gauge value to display (e.g. 92 for 92%)

maxValue.description: Maximum value for the gauge scale

label.description: Text label shown below the ring (e.g. 'System Uptime')

suffix.description: Suffix appended to the number display (e.g. '%', '/5', 'pts')

comparisonValue.description: Optional second value shown as a thinner ring for comparison (e.g. last quarter's value)

comparisonLabel.description: Label for the comparison value (e.g. 'Last Quarter')

trackColor.description: Color of the unfilled track ring
